Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Independent leaf review, relayed by the implementer: the reviewer did not author or edit this change. It reviewed frozen tree `b24e175fbe51e79a54a4d8042ec92a3ea19a649a`, which is exactly commit `85076f40f3567f0525293aaa48b4b280bb41b373`'s tree, against current main/base `a6bd69d8527e0752cc58e6a02c1dae4971355268`. Main is the branch's direct ancestor; no trial-merge changes were necessary.

- Cohesive private spiral/orbit seam; complete moved definitions, constant values and planning/refusal order preserved. Only required method visibility and imports change.
- `lift.rs` is doc-comment reflow only. All 30 adaptive files are <=400 lines; test/ignore inventories and tracked golden/snapshot blobs are unchanged.
- Reviewer-executed Windows results: motion lib190 passed/1ignored; adaptive_band2 passed; adaptive_hsm1 passed/5ignored; adaptive_orbit_seam1 passed; pocket3d_hsm3 passed/1ignored. Total197 passed,0 failed,7 ignored.
- Motion all-targets Clippy and focused diff whitespace check passed. Both native command receipts were completed/drained with exit0 and unchanged frozen source identities; the implementer separately read and verified them.

Requested before merge: none. No actionable findings.

Limits: ignored heavy/release tests and runtime golden-output regeneration were not run; the explicit touched-binaries+Clippy alternative was used rather than automatic xtask quick. Hosted checks are absent, not green. No algorithm/tolerance/dependency change or #982 implementation.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
